premise.claim: Cache systems with no FUSE client (e.g. Mooncake) give app pods no way to learn the runtime config: 'app pod that mounts the PVC stays in ContainerCreating forever'; apps 'talk to the cache service directly' but the master address had to be hardcoded. Stage 1 (runtime.sh in the runtime-config ConfigMap, #6191) is already merged. Additionally the webhook ClusterRole lacks cacheruntimes, so base.GetRuntimeInfo blocks ~15s and pod creation fails for CacheRuntime datasets.
premise.patchedComponent: pkg/webhook (mutating handler, new RuntimeConfigInjector plugin), charts/fluid/fluid (webhook rule, plugin profile, RBAC), pkg/ddc/cache/engine (constant reuse)
premise.evidence: merge-base e0fc4c1 already contains generateRuntimeSh (pkg/ddc/cache/engine/cm.go) i.e. stage 1 exists; base chart has 0 occurrences of 'clientless' in webhookconfiguration.yaml and 0 of 'cacheruntimes' in the webhook ClusterRole (results/helm-template-checks.txt); base.GetRuntimeInfo reads CacheRuntime through the webhook's cached client (pkg/ddc/base/runtime.go:633, handler registered with mgr.GetClient() in pkg/webhook/handler/register.go:52)
